statement: ∀ {X : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] (O U : Set X), Dense O → IsOpen U → U.Nonempty → (O ∩ U).Nonempty

plain_statement.zh: 把稠密轨道用于可命中的开靶区
plain_statement.en: Transfer dense-orbit information to an open target

brief.zh: 此工具要求靶区开且非空。应用时核对靶区是否真的具有正宽度及其误差如何回到整数。
brief.en: Check that the target is open and nonempty and account for the error when lifting to integers.
